title: AirMonitor Print Window
description: Sensor history from 30 minutes before a selected print entered RUNNING until 30 minutes after it ended.

list.name: print_id
list.label: Print
list.query: SELECT printf('%s — %s — %s (#%d)', substr(started_at, 1, 16), COALESCE(NULLIF(subtask_name, ''), 'Unnamed print'), COALESCE(NULLIF(filament_type, ''), 'unknown filament'), id) AS __text, CAST(id AS TEXT) AS __value FROM prints WHERE started_gcode_state = 'RUNNING' OR last_gcode_state = 'RUNNING' OR ended_gcode_state IS NOT NULL ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 12;

targets.queryText: SELECT subtask_name AS print, COALESCE(NULLIF(filament_type, ''), 'Not captured') AS material, CASE WHEN length(trim(COALESCE(filament_color, ''))) >= 6 THEN '#' || upper(substr(trim(filament_color), 1, 6)) ELSE 'Not captured' END AS color, COALESCE(NULLIF(filament_sub_brand, ''), NULLIF(filament_profile, ''), 'Not captured') AS filament_profile, strftime('%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', started_at, 'localtime') AS running_started_local, strftime('%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', COALESCE(ended_at, last_seen_at), 'localtime') AS print_ended_local, strftime('%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', started_at, '-30 minutes', 'localtime') AS chart_from_local, strftime('%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', COALESCE(ended_at, last_seen_at), '+30 minutes', 'localtime') AS chart_to_local, COALESCE(ended_gcode_state, last_gcode_state) AS final_state FROM prints WHERE id = CAST('$print_id' AS INTEGER);
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT subtask_name AS print, COALESCE(NULLIF(filament_type, ''), 'Not captured') AS material, CASE WHEN length(trim(COALESCE(filament_color, ''))) >= 6 THEN '#' || upper(substr(trim(filament_color), 1, 6)) ELSE 'Not captured' END AS color, COALESCE(NULLIF(filament_sub_brand, ''), NULLIF(filament_profile, ''), 'Not captured') AS filament_profile, strftime('%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', started_at, 'localtime') AS running_started_local, strftime('%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', COALESCE(ended_at, last_seen_at), 'localtime') AS print_ended_local, strftime('%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', started_at, '-30 minutes', 'localtime') AS chart_from_local, strftime('%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', COALESCE(ended_at, last_seen_at), '+30 minutes', 'localtime') AS chart_to_local, COALESCE(ended_gcode_state, last_gcode_state) AS final_state FROM prints WHERE id = CAST('$print_id' AS INTEGER);

panels.title: VOC — 30 Minutes Before Through 30 Minutes After

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', s.sampled_at) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time, s.gas_ppm AS voc_ppm FROM sgx_voc_samples s, prints p WHERE p.id = CAST('$print_id' AS INTEGER) AND datetime(s.sampled_at) BETWEEN datetime(p.started_at, '-30 minutes') AND datetime(COALESCE(p.ended_at, p.last_seen_at), '+30 minutes') ORDER BY s.sampled_at;
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', s.sampled_at) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time, s.gas_ppm AS voc_ppm FROM sgx_voc_samples s, prints p WHERE p.id = CAST('$print_id' AS INTEGER) AND datetime(s.sampled_at) BETWEEN datetime(p.started_at, '-30 minutes') AND datetime(COALESCE(p.ended_at, p.last_seen_at), '+30 minutes') ORDER BY s.sampled_at;

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', s.sampled_at) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time, s.temperature_c, s.humidity_rh, s.chamber_temperature_c FROM sgx_voc_samples s, prints p WHERE p.id = CAST('$print_id' AS INTEGER) AND datetime(s.sampled_at) BETWEEN datetime(p.started_at, '-30 minutes') AND datetime(COALESCE(p.ended_at, p.last_seen_at), '+30 minutes') ORDER BY s.sampled_at;
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', s.sampled_at) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time, s.temperature_c, s.humidity_rh, s.chamber_temperature_c FROM sgx_voc_samples s, prints p WHERE p.id = CAST('$print_id' AS INTEGER) AND datetime(s.sampled_at) BETWEEN datetime(p.started_at, '-30 minutes') AND datetime(COALESCE(p.ended_at, p.last_seen_at), '+30 minutes') ORDER BY s.sampled_at;

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', s.sampled_at) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time, s.mass_pm1_0 AS PM1, s.mass_pm2_5 AS PM2_5, s.mass_pm4_0 AS PM4, s.mass_pm10 AS PM10 FROM sps30_samples s, prints p WHERE p.id = CAST('$print_id' AS INTEGER) AND datetime(s.sampled_at) BETWEEN datetime(p.started_at, '-30 minutes') AND datetime(COALESCE(p.ended_at, p.last_seen_at), '+30 minutes') ORDER BY s.sampled_at;
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', s.sampled_at) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time, s.mass_pm1_0 AS PM1, s.mass_pm2_5 AS PM2_5, s.mass_pm4_0 AS PM4, s.mass_pm10 AS PM10 FROM sps30_samples s, prints p WHERE p.id = CAST('$print_id' AS INTEGER) AND datetime(s.sampled_at) BETWEEN datetime(p.started_at, '-30 minutes') AND datetime(COALESCE(p.ended_at, p.last_seen_at), '+30 minutes') ORDER BY s.sampled_at;

panels.title: Minimum and Maximum Across Selected Span

targets.queryText: WITH bounds AS (SELECT datetime(started_at, '-30 minutes') AS from_at, datetime(COALESCE(ended_at, last_seen_at), '+30 minutes') AS to_at FROM prints WHERE id = CAST('$print_id' AS INTEGER)), sgx AS (SELECT * FROM sgx_voc_samples, bounds WHERE datetime(sampled_at) BETWEEN from_at AND to_at), sps AS (SELECT * FROM sps30_samples, bounds WHERE datetime(sampled_at) BETWEEN from_at AND to_at) SELECT 'VOC' AS sensor, ROUND(MIN(gas_ppm), 3) AS minimum, ROUND(MAX(gas_ppm), 3) AS maximum, 'ppm' AS unit FROM sgx UNION ALL SELECT 'Temperature', ROUND(MIN(temperature_c), 2), ROUND(MAX(temperature_c), 2), '°C' FROM sgx UNION ALL SELECT 'Humidity', ROUND(MIN(humidity_rh), 2), ROUND(MAX(humidity_rh), 2), '%RH' FROM sgx UNION ALL SELECT 'PM1.0 mass', ROUND(MIN(mass_pm1_0), 2), ROUND(MAX(mass_pm1_0), 2), 'µg/m³' FROM sps UNION ALL SELECT 'PM2.5 mass', ROUND(MIN(mass_pm2_5), 2), ROUND(MAX(mass_pm2_5), 2), 'µg/m³' FROM sps UNION ALL SELECT 'PM4.0 mass', ROUND(MIN(mass_pm4_0), 2), ROUND(MAX(mass_pm4_0), 2), 'µg/m³' FROM sps UNION ALL SELECT 'PM10 mass', ROUND(MIN(mass_pm10), 2), ROUND(MAX(mass_pm10), 2), 'µg/m³' FROM sps UNION ALL SELECT 'Typical particle size', ROUND(MIN(typical_particle_size), 3), ROUND(MAX(typical_particle_size), 3), 'µm' FROM sps;
targets.rawQueryText: WITH bounds AS (SELECT datetime(started_at, '-30 minutes') AS from_at, datetime(COALESCE(ended_at, last_seen_at), '+30 minutes') AS to_at FROM prints WHERE id = CAST('$print_id' AS INTEGER)), sgx AS (SELECT * FROM sgx_voc_samples, bounds WHERE datetime(sampled_at) BETWEEN from_at AND to_at), sps AS (SELECT * FROM sps30_samples, bounds WHERE datetime(sampled_at) BETWEEN from_at AND to_at) SELECT 'VOC' AS sensor, ROUND(MIN(gas_ppm), 3) AS minimum, ROUND(MAX(gas_ppm), 3) AS maximum, 'ppm' AS unit FROM sgx UNION ALL SELECT 'Temperature', ROUND(MIN(temperature_c), 2), ROUND(MAX(temperature_c), 2), '°C' FROM sgx UNION ALL SELECT 'Humidity', ROUND(MIN(humidity_rh), 2), ROUND(MAX(humidity_rh), 2), '%RH' FROM sgx UNION ALL SELECT 'PM1.0 mass', ROUND(MIN(mass_pm1_0), 2), ROUND(MAX(mass_pm1_0), 2), 'µg/m³' FROM sps UNION ALL SELECT 'PM2.5 mass', ROUND(MIN(mass_pm2_5), 2), ROUND(MAX(mass_pm2_5), 2), 'µg/m³' FROM sps UNION ALL SELECT 'PM4.0 mass', ROUND(MIN(mass_pm4_0), 2), ROUND(MAX(mass_pm4_0), 2), 'µg/m³' FROM sps UNION ALL SELECT 'PM10 mass', ROUND(MIN(mass_pm10), 2), ROUND(MAX(mass_pm10), 2), 'µg/m³' FROM sps UNION ALL SELECT 'Typical particle size', ROUND(MIN(typical_particle_size), 3), ROUND(MAX(typical_particle_size), 3), 'µm' FROM sps;
